sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows how to plan before computing anything.

items.prompt: A movie starts at 2:15 p.m. and lasts 40 minutes. What time does it end?

steps: Start at 2:15 p.m. and count forward 40 minutes.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Decide what the quantities are before you compute anything.

items.prompt: A container has 267 kilograms. Another 154 kilograms are poured in. How many kilograms are in the container now?
Practice starts at 12:45 p.m. and lasts 81 minutes. What time does practice end?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Plan in writing: what you will figure out, how, and how you will check it.

items.prompt: A container has 553 grams. Another 179 grams are poured in. How many grams are in the container now?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Practice starts at 12:45 p.m. and lasts 84 minutes. What time does practice end?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
